list.head: Background Information
list.item: Comments: Charles B. Hayes is guardian for Frederick Winthrop Pearl Hays, soldier's heir and orphan child of Henry M. Pearl. File contains affidavit explaining the suspension of the original approval because the legal description was advertised incorrectly the time of the first public notice and that no one appeared in protest after the second, corrected notice. Records of military service are for Henry M. Pearl. File also contains affidavit swearing that Mary E. Pearl, mother of Frederick Winthrop Pearl Hays was deceased and was the only wife of Henry M. Pearl and that Frederick Winthrop Pearl Hays has heard the contents of the affidavit and he believes them to be true. Also contains affidavit by Charles B. Hays that he is the identical person who made homestead application as guardian of Frederick Winthrop Pearl Hays and that he is the adopted father of Frederick Winthrop Pearl Hays. Finalized information is for Charles B. Hays, not Frederick Winthrop Pearl Hays. Also contains copy of adoption papers.
